CREATE TABLE pc_share_rule_heads (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, rule_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id) REFERENCES pc_scopes (scope_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_share_rule_heads_version_positive CHECK (version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_share_rule_heads_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'invalidated'))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_share_rule_versions (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	terms_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, rule_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, rule_id) REFERENCES pc_share_rule_heads (scope_id, rule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_share_rule_versions_version_positive CHECK (version > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_share_acceptances (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	terms_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	covered_scope_ids BLOB NOT NULL, 
	acceptance_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, rule_id, version, actor, side), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, rule_id, version) REFERENCES pc_share_rule_versions (scope_id, rule_id, version) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_share_acceptances_id UNIQUE (acceptance_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_share_acceptances_side CHECK (side IN ('origin', 'audience'))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_share_snapshots (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	rule_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	terms_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	membership_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	notification_key VARCHAR(128), 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	dream_run_id VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, snapshot_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id) REFERENCES pc_scopes (scope_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_share_snapshots_notification UNIQUE (scope_id, rule_id, notification_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_share_snapshots_run UNIQUE (scope_id, dream_run_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_share_snapshots_rule_version_positive CHECK (rule_version > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_lineage_origins (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	origin_scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	origin_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	origin_family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	origin_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	origin_revision INTEGER, 
	locator BLOB, 
	digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_lineage_origins_kind CHECK (origin_kind IN ('source', 'artifact')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_lineage_origins_revision CHECK ((origin_kind = 'source' AND origin_revision IS NULL) OR (origin_kind = 'artifact' AND origin_revision > 0))
)
